history.content: i dont really know why im here. nothing feels wrong exactly. just kind of flat lately
That sounds more like flatness than something sharply wrong. Does it feel more numb, blank, or just hard to name?
blank i guess. like im just going thru the motions. wake up work eat sleep. none of it lands
"Going through the motions" and "none of it lands" feels like the centre of this. Is it more like blank on the inside, or more like detached from it all?
detached maybe. idk. my contract ends in august and i havent done anything about it. should be freaking out probably but i just. dont feel anything about it
The contract ending in August is there, but it doesn't seem to be reaching you yet. I'm wondering if this is more detached, or maybe a kind of blank that stays in place when something is looming?
yeah blank that stays. everyones asking whats next for you and i just shrug. i used to have like plans and now its just static. cant picture anything past august honestly
“Static” and not being able to picture past August feel like the shape of this. I can leave it there, or stay with what that blank is doing to the idea of what comes next.
i think the static is easier than actually looking at it. if i dont picture anything then i cant be disappointed i guess. dunno. thats kind of all i got tonight
That sounds like the blank is doing a job for you, keeping disappointment out of reach. We can leave it there for tonight.
yeah. lets leave it there. thanks for not pushing. night
Goodnight. I’ll leave it right there with you.

prevEvent.appraisal_thought: If I don't picture anything, I can't be disappointed.
prevEvent.memory_note: User tends to go blank around uncertainty about what comes next, especially with the contract ending in August.
